newsitem.title: SYRIA: Official Syrian paper condemns Hebron shooting.
newsitem.headline: Official Syrian paper condemns Hebron shooting.

text.p: The shooting of Palestinians in Hebron by an off-duty Israeli soldier demonstrates that it is impossible to make peace while Israel continues to occupy Arab lands, an official Syrian newspaper commented on Thursday.
"Like all other previous Israeli crimes, yesterday's crime proved that peace and occupation could never meet because they contradict each other," al-Thawra said.

"The crime showed that settlements are nothing but time bombs which could explode at any time. This means that it is impossible to achieve peace while Jewish settlements continued to exist on Arab lands," the newspaper commented.

Seven Palestinians were wounded when an off-duty Israeli soldier sprayed bullets in a Hebron market on Wednesday in an attempt to block a deal on Israel's handover of the Hebron town to Palestinian self-rule.
